name: sk-card
purpose: Generic surface card with optional image, title, and body content.

slots.footer-start: Card footer metadata or supporting text
slots.footer-end: Card footer action or trailing content

do: Provide hover feedback for interactive cards.
Use the image variant when the card needs a visual stage.
Use the selected variant for toggleable cards.
Use the default slot for supporting copy and the footer slots for metadata and actions.
dont: Do not nest cards inside cards.
Do not use without a visible title for screen readers.

code.example: <sk-card variant="image" title="Graphic Form and Spatial Memory" subtitle="Research · 2024" image-src="/cover.jpg"><sk-text size="lg">How bold geometric reduction in postwar Japanese poster design encodes cultural memory and political meaning through shape alone.</sk-text><sk-caption slot="footer-start">Kamekura, Y. - 12 min</sk-caption><sk-text slot="footer-end">Read →</sk-text></sk-card>
